repairs.quote: At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his Attacks to deal an additional ((11 ~ 60) + (45% Ability Power) + (20% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage to the target and 4 closest enemies.
Volibear gains (5% + (4% per 100 Ability Power)) Attack Speed for 6 seconds whenever he deals damage with an Ability or Attack, stacking up to 5 times.

proposalDecisions.reason: 5는 적중 횟수가 아닌 현재공속중첩이므로 resource eq5로 변경했다.

limitations.note: 공급 원문과 대조했으며 상세 조건 또는 수식을 확정하지 않고 해당 한계를 보존한다.
